chemical.name: Urea (46% N)
chemical.purpose: Corrects acute nitrogen deficiency to support vegetative growth and chlorophyll synthesis.
chemical.application_notes: Apply in 2-3 split doses to reduce leaching and ammonia volatilization loss; avoid application immediately before heavy rainfall.
chemical.cautions: Excess application delays maturity, induces lodging, and increases susceptibility to sucking pests.
chemical.source: ICAR Soil Testing & Fertilizer Recommendation Guidelines (2015)

chemical.name: Ammonium Sulphate (21% N, 24% S)
chemical.purpose: Supplies ammoniacal nitrogen along with essential sulphur; particularly beneficial in neutral to alkaline soils.
chemical.application_notes: Useful where sulphur is also deficient; has a mild acidifying effect on high-pH soils.
chemical.cautions: Avoid repeated heavy use on strongly acidic soils without liming.

organic.name: Farmyard Manure (FYM)
organic.purpose: Gradually builds soil nitrogen reserve while enhancing soil biological activity and water-holding capacity.
organic.application_notes: Apply well-decomposed FYM 2-3 weeks before sowing and incorporate thoroughly into the top 15 cm of soil.
organic.cautions: Must be well-decomposed to avoid nitrogen immobilization (tie-up) and weed seed introduction.
organic.source: ICAR Organic Farming & Soil Fertility Practices

organic.name: Vermicompost
organic.purpose: Supplies readily available organic nitrogen, beneficial microbes, and plant growth-promoting enzymes.
organic.application_notes: Mix into topsoil near the root zone at planting or early vegetative stages.
organic.cautions: Store in shade and maintain adequate moisture to preserve microbial viability.
organic.source: ICAR Organic Farming & Soil Fertility Practices

chemical.name: Single Super Phosphate (SSP, 16% P2O5, 11% S, 19% Ca)
chemical.purpose: Supplies readily available water-soluble phosphorus for early root establishment and energy transfer (ATP).
chemical.application_notes: Apply as a basal dose at sowing near the root zone; phosphorus is immobile in soil and must be placed where roots can reach it.
chemical.cautions: Avoid surface broadcasting; phosphorus fixes quickly in strongly acidic or calcareous soils.

chemical.name: Di-Ammonium Phosphate (DAP, 18% N, 46% P2O5)
chemical.purpose: Concentrated starter fertilizer supplying high phosphorus with starter nitrogen for seedling vigour.
chemical.application_notes: Apply basal at sowing placed 3-5 cm below and to the side of the seed line.
chemical.cautions: Avoid direct seed contact to prevent ammonia injury to emerging radicals.

organic.name: Rock Phosphate (Promoted with PSB)
organic.purpose: Slow-release phosphorus source that improves soil mineral reserves naturally.
organic.application_notes: Apply in acidic soils (pH < 6.5) along with Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria (PSB) and organic manure to accelerate dissolution.
organic.cautions: Very low solubility in alkaline or calcareous soils; ineffective on soils with pH > 7.5.

organic.name: Bone Meal (Raw / Steamed)
organic.purpose: Slow-acting natural phosphorus and calcium source suitable for perennial and organic vegetable farming.
organic.application_notes: Incorporate thoroughly into soil before planting or as a basal pit dressing.
organic.cautions: Requires soil microbial action to release plant-available phosphate.

chemical.name: Muriate of Potash (MOP / KCl, 60% K2O)
chemical.purpose: Corrects potassium deficiency, regulates stomatal water loss, and enhances disease/drought resistance.
chemical.application_notes: Apply basal or in two splits on sandy soils with low cation-exchange capacity.
chemical.cautions: Contains chloride; avoid on chloride-sensitive crops like tobacco, potato, and grapes.
chemical.source: ICAR Soil Testing & Fertilizer Recommendation Guidelines (2015)

chemical.name: Sulphate of Potash (SOP / K2SO4, 50% K2O, 17.5% S)
chemical.purpose: Chloride-free potassium source that also supplies sulphur, ideal for high-value horticultural crops.
chemical.application_notes: Apply basal or via fertigation during peak flowering and fruit development.
chemical.cautions: More expensive per unit K than MOP; reserve for chloride-sensitive crops or high-salinity soils.

organic.name: Wood Ash (Clean / Untreated)
organic.purpose: Traditional organic potash source (4-10% K2O) containing calcium and magnesium.
organic.application_notes: Incorporate lightly into topsoil or compost heap.
organic.cautions: Has a strong liming effect (raises pH); avoid applying to soils that are already alkaline (pH > 7.5).

organic.name: Composted Banana Pseudo-stem / Agricultural Residue
organic.purpose: Potassium-rich farm waste recycling to replenish exchangeable potassium.
organic.cautions: Ensure complete composting to eliminate pest carriers.
organic.source: ICAR Organic Farming & Soil Fertility Practices

organic.name: Green Manure (Dhaincha / Sunhemp)
organic.purpose: Increases soil organic carbon, fixes atmospheric nitrogen, and improves soil structure and permeability.
organic.application_notes: Sow at 25-30 kg seed/ha and plough under at 45-50 days (flowering stage), allowing 10-15 days for decomposition before planting main crop.
organic.cautions: Requires adequate soil moisture for rapid microbial decomposition.
organic.source: ICAR National Project on Organic Farming

organic.name: Well-Decomposed Farmyard Manure (FYM) / Compost
organic.purpose: Restores depleted soil organic matter, increases cation exchange capacity (CEC), and buffers soil pH.
organic.application_notes: Incorporate 8-10 tonnes/ha across crop rotations; requires sustained multi-season commitment.
organic.cautions: Not an instantaneous one-week fix; benefits accumulate over multiple seasons.
organic.source: ICAR Organic Farming & Soil Fertility Practices

chemical.name: Zinc Sulphate Heptahydrate (ZnSO4.7H2O, 21% Zn)
chemical.purpose: Alleviates acute zinc deficiency, vital for auxin synthesis and enzyme activation.
chemical.application_notes: Apply as a soil basal dose (20-25 kg/ha) or as a 0.5% foliar spray neutralized with lime for standing crop deficiency.
chemical.cautions: Do not mix directly with phosphatic fertilizers in spray tank to avoid insoluble zinc phosphate precipitation.

organic.name: Zinc-Enriched Farmyard Manure
organic.purpose: Natural chelation of zinc with organic acids, enhancing bioavailability in alkaline soils.
organic.application_notes: Incubate zinc sulphate with moist FYM (1:10 ratio) for 3-4 weeks prior to basal application.
organic.cautions: Plan incubation period ahead of sowing schedule.

chemical.name: Ferrous Sulphate (FeSO4.7H2O, 19% Fe)
chemical.purpose: Corrects iron chlorosis (yellowing between leaf veins) in new leaves.
chemical.application_notes: Foliar spray of 0.5-1.0% solution with 0.1% citric acid is far more effective than soil application in alkaline soils.
chemical.cautions: Soil applications often precipitate rapidly as insoluble ferric hydroxide in calcareous soils (pH > 7.5).

organic.name: Compost & Organic Mulch with Humic Substances
organic.purpose: Natural siderophores and humic fractions chelate iron, preventing fixation in high-pH soils.
organic.application_notes: Apply around plant drip line to lower rhizosphere pH micro-environment.
organic.cautions: Acts gradually over the growing season.

chemical.name: Agricultural Gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O, 13-18% S, 20-22% Ca)
chemical.purpose: Supplies readily available sulphate-sulphur for amino acid synthesis without altering soil pH.
chemical.application_notes: Apply 200-250 kg/ha as a basal broadcast and incorporate into soil at final land preparation.
chemical.cautions: Ensure good soil moisture for dissolution.

chemical.name: Bentonite Sulphur (Pastille, 90% S)
chemical.purpose: High-concentration slow-release elemental sulphur for multi-season sulphur buffering.
chemical.cautions: Requires microbial oxidation in soil before becoming plant-available sulphate; slow initial release in cool or dry soils.

organic.name: Decomposed Farmyard Manure & Oilcake Blend
organic.purpose: Organic source of sulphur derived from plant protein mineralization.
organic.cautions: Sulphur release rate depends on soil temperature and microbial activity.

chemical.name: Borax (Sodium Tetraborate, 10.5% B) / Solubor (20% B)
chemical.purpose: Crucial for pollen viability, cell wall formation, fruit setting, and sugar translocation.
chemical.application_notes: Soil application of 5-10 kg/ha borax basal, or foliar spray of 0.1-0.2% Solubor at flower bud initiation.
chemical.cautions: Very narrow threshold between deficiency and toxicity; do NOT exceed recommended dosages.

organic.name: Boron-Enriched Compost / Vermicompost
organic.purpose: Safe, slow-release delivery of boron buffered by organic colloids to avoid localized toxicity.
organic.application_notes: Mix into soil during bed preparation.
organic.cautions: Test soil boron levels annually when using regular micronutrient composts.

chemical.name: Copper Sulphate (CuSO4.5H2O, 24% Cu)
chemical.purpose: Corrects copper deficiency, essential for photosynthesis, respiration, and lignin synthesis.
chemical.application_notes: Soil application of 5-10 kg/ha or 0.1% neutralized foliar spray.
chemical.cautions: Copper accumulates in soil; avoid repeated heavy applications to prevent microflora toxicity.

organic.name: Well-Aged Farmyard Manure with Organic Chelation
organic.purpose: Maintains low but steady copper availability in native soil solutions.

chemical.name: Manganese Sulphate (MnSO4, 30.5% Mn)
chemical.purpose: Restores manganese required for water-splitting in photosynthesis and nitrogen assimilation.
chemical.application_notes: Foliar spray of 0.5% solution is preferred on alkaline or calcareous soils where soil Mn is rapidly immobilized.
chemical.cautions: Do not spray during intense mid-day heat or direct sunlight.

organic.name: Compost / Farmyard Manure Incorporation
organic.purpose: Supplies trace manganese and organic chelators to enhance micronutrient mobility.
organic.application_notes: Incorporate into topsoil during pre-sowing plowing.
organic.cautions: Availability decreases as soil pH rises above 7.2.

chemical.name: Agricultural Lime (Calcium Carbonate, CaCO3)
chemical.purpose: Neutralizes toxic soil acidity (pH < 5.5), precipitates harmful soluble aluminium and manganese, and supplies calcium.
chemical.application_notes: Broadcast and incorporate thoroughly into the top 15 cm of soil 3-4 weeks prior to planting.
chemical.cautions: Do not over-lime; aim to bring soil pH to 6.2-6.5 rather than 7.5 to preserve micronutrient availability.

chemical.name: Dolomitic Limestone (CaCO3 + MgCO3)
chemical.purpose: Corrects soil acidity while simultaneously addressing magnesium deficiency common in weathered acidic soils.
chemical.application_notes: Apply 3-4 weeks before sowing with thorough tillage.
chemical.cautions: Test soil magnesium before applying large quantities.

organic.name: Wood Ash / Biochar Compost
organic.purpose: Gentle, alkaline organic amendment that raises acidic soil pH and supplies basic cations.
organic.application_notes: Mix into soil during land preparation.
organic.source: ICAR Organic Farming & Soil Amendment Reference

chemical.name: Agricultural Gypsum (Calcium Sulphate, CaSO4.2H2O)
chemical.purpose: Reclaims sodic / alkaline soils (pH > 8.0) by replacing exchangeable sodium on soil colloids with soluble calcium.
chemical.application_notes: Broadcast and incorporate into soil, followed by heavy irrigation and drainage to leach displaced sodium salts.
chemical.cautions: Adequate drainage is mandatory; without leaching, replaced sodium remains in the root zone.
chemical.source: Central Soil Salinity Research Institute (CSSRI) / ICAR Guidelines

organic.name: Green Manuring with Dhaincha (Sesbania) & FYM
organic.purpose: Generates organic acids and carbon dioxide during decomposition that solubilize native calcium carbonate and lower rhizosphere pH.
organic.application_notes: Plough under green manure at 45 days and maintain soil moisture.
organic.cautions: Takes continuous management across 2-3 seasons for lasting soil structure reclamation.
organic.source: CSSRI / ICAR Sodic Soil Reclamation Practices
